records.mutant: delete field kind from struct BackendError expression in refused
records.reason: INVALID_INPUT is 0 in backend.proto, the proto3 default, so deleting the field leaves the same value.
records.evidence: refused builds BackendError with ..BackendError::default(), and the default kind is the enum's zero, INVALID_INPUT. A proto3 scalar at its default is not encoded, so the bytes with the field and without it are equal, and no test can tell the two apart.

records.reason: The mutated `target_default` is the `wasm32` one, which `#[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]` removes from every native build, so the mutant compiles to the very program the original does.
records.evidence: `crates/engine-core/src/files.rs` line 52 gates this `target_default` on target_arch = "wasm32" and line 59 gates its native twin on the opposite, so `cargo mutants` lists both under one name and builds this one natively as the unchanged crate; the twin's mutant is unviable in the same run. The `FailClosed` port it returns is asserted natively by `one_way::an_uninstalled_browser_port_refuses_every_choice_path`, whose row `S37702` is killed by hand.
